text: {"findings": [{"file": "github/github.go", "line_start": 892, "line_end": 894, "category": "security", "description": "The new fast-path check uses strings.Contains(urlStr, \"..\") on the raw, still percent-encoded URL string before parsing. A path segment encoded as \"%2e%2e\" (or mixed-case variants) does not contain the literal substring \"..\", so this check returns nil and skips url.Parse/segment inspection entirely, even though url.Parse would decode it to a literal \"..\" path segment. This allows an attacker to bypass the path-traversal protection by percent-encoding the dots.", "confidence": 0.7}]}
